title: fix(arcade-cli): update default Anthropic eval model to claude-sonnet-5-5

files.patch:
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ arcade evals examples/evals/eval_arcade_gateway.py \
 # Compare multiple models
 arcade evals examples/evals/eval_stdio_mcp_server.py \
     -p openai:gpt-4o \
-    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 \
+    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 \
     -k openai:YOUR_OPENAI_KEY \
     -k anthropic:YOUR_ANTHROPIC_KEY
 
@@ -207,7 +207,7 @@ export ARCADE_USER_ID=your_user_id
 
 arcade evals examples/evals/eval_comprehensive_comparison.py \
     -p openai:gpt-4o \
-    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 \
+    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 \
     -k openai:YOUR_KEY \
     -k anthropic:YOUR_KEY \
     -o comparison.html -d
@@ -251,7 +251,7 @@ arcade evals eval_file.py -p openai:gpt-4o,gpt-4o-mini -k openai:YOUR_KEY
 ```bash
 arcade evals eval_file.py \
     -p openai:gpt-4o \
-    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 \
+    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 \
     -k openai:YOUR_KEY \
     -k anthropic:YOUR_KEY
 ```
@@ -295,7 +295,7 @@ arcade evals examples/evals/eval_arcade_gateway.py \
 ```bash
 arcade evals examples/evals/eval_stdio_mcp_server.py \
     -p openai:gpt-4o \
-    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 \
+    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 \
     -k openai:YOUR_OPENAI_KEY \
     -k anthropic:YOUR_ANTHROPIC_KEY \
     -o battle.html -d
@@ -315,7 +315,7 @@ arcade evals examples/evals/eval_http_mcp_server.py \
 # Compare performance across multiple tool sources
 arcade evals examples/evals/eval_comprehensive_comparison.py \
     -p openai:gpt-4o \
-    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 \
+    -p anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 \
     -k openai:YOUR_KEY \
     -k anthropic:YOUR_KEY \
     -o comparison.html -d

@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 
 Run:
     arcade evals examples/evals/eval_comprehensive_comparison.py \\
-        -p "openai:gpt-4o anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929" \\
+        -p "openai:gpt-4o anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5" \\
         -k openai:YOUR_KEY -k anthropic:YOUR_KEY \\
         -o comparison.html -d
 """

@@ -663,7 +663,7 @@ def evals(
         "--use-provider",
         "-p",
         help="Provider(s) and models to use. Format: 'provider' or 'provider:model1,model2'. "
-        "Can be repeated. Examples: --use-provider openai or --use-provider openai:gpt-4o --use-provider anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
+        "Can be repeated. Examples: --use-provider openai or --use-provider openai:gpt-4o --use-provider anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5",
     ),
     api_key: Optional[list[str]] = typer.Option(
         None,

@@ -81,13 +81,13 @@ class Provider(str, Enum):
 # Edit these values to change the default models used by the CLI.
 # These are used when --models is not specified.
 #
-# Note: Anthropic models include date suffixes (e.g., -20250929) which may need
+# Note: Some Anthropic models include date suffixes which may need
 # periodic updates. Check https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models
 # for the latest model identifiers.
 
 DEFAULT_MODELS: dict[Provider, str] = {
     Provider.OPENAI: "gpt-4o",
-    Provider.ANTHROPIC: "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
+    Provider.ANTHROPIC: "claude-sonnet-5-5",
 }
 
 
@@ -251,7 +251,7 @@ def parse_provider_spec(spec: str) -> ProviderConfig:
         spec: Provider spec string. Examples:
             - "openai" -> use OpenAI with default model
             - "openai:gpt-4o" -> use OpenAI with gpt-4o
-            - "anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929,claude-3-haiku-20240307"
+            - "anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5,claude-haiku-5-5"
 
     Returns:
         ProviderConfig with parsed provider and models.

@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@ def test_get_default_model_openai(self) -> None:
 
     def test_get_default_model_anthropic(self) -> None:
         """Test get_default_model returns correct model for Anthropic."""
-        assert get_default_model(Provider.ANTHROPIC) == "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929"
+        assert get_default_model(Provider.ANTHROPIC) == "claude-sonnet-5-5"
 
     def test_default_models_are_valid_strings(self) -> None:
         """Test that all default models are non-empty strings."""

 [project]
 name = "arcade-mcp"
-version = "1.17.1"
+version = "1.17.2"
 description = "Arcade.dev - Tool Calling platform for Agents"
 readme = "README.md"
